channel.title: Ocean News & Technology Magazine - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Ocean News & Technology Magazine (oceannews.com)

item.title: EdgeTech Introduces the Trace Micro-UUV, ROV, and USV Based Side Scan Sonar System
item.description: EdgeTech, the leader in high resolution sonar imaging systems and acoustic release solutions, has recently expanded their OEM side scan sonar product offering to meet the needs of small and micro sized autonomous vehicles.

item.title: Kongsberg Maritime to Supply an Integrated Technology Package for LS Marine Solution’s Cable Lay Vessel
item.description: Kongsberg Maritime has been selected to deliver an extensive and fully integrated equipment package for the next-generation ultra-large cable lay vessel being built for LS Marine Solution at Tersan Shipyard in Türkiye.

item.title: NexusWave Powers Vega Reederei’s New Eco Fleet with Bonded Connectivity
item.description: Inmarsat Maritime, part of Viasat Communication Services, has secured a deal with long-term customer Vega Reederei to equip 10 of its new diesel-electric coaster vessels with the cutting-edge NexusWave connectivity service. The agreement also includes advanced cyber-security solutions Fleet Secure Unified Threat Management (UTM) and Fleet Secure Endpoint.

item.title: HAVELSAN Hosts Ceremony for SANCAR Armed Unmanned Surface Vehicle Commissioning
item.description: With the participation of President of the Republic of Türkiye, H.E. Recep Tayyip ERDOĞAN, the commissioning ceremony of the SANCAR Armed Unmanned Surface Vehicle (AUSV), the groundbreaking ceremony of the HAVELSAN Simulator Production and Integration Facility, and the inauguration ceremonies of the HAVELSAN KAAN Technology Center and the Naval Combat Management Systems Additional Facility were held at HAVELSAN’s Technology Campus.

item.title: TKMS and Israel Aerospace Industries Hand Over BlueWhale AUV to the German Navy
item.description: TKMS and Israel Aerospace Industries (IAI) announced the delivery of the BlueWhale large autonomous underwater vehicle (AUV) to the German Navy. The handover took place at the Eckernförde naval base, marking a significant milestone for autonomous underwater systems and is a key component in TKMS's efforts to expand the maritime ecosystem of the future. item.title: Lithuania, Latvia, and Germany Asses the Possibilities of an Offshore Interconnection
item.description: The energy ministers of Lithuania, Latvia, and Germany signed a joint declaration of intent on cross border renewable electricity capacity and infrastructure. The Lithuanian (Litgrid), Latvian (Augstsprieguma tīkls), and German (50Hertz) electricity transmission system operators agreed to assess the feasibility of the Baltic–German PowerLink hybrid electricity interconnection.

item.title: Albanese Government Announces Acquisition of Long-Lead Items for AUKUS Nuclear Propulsion Systems
item.description: The Albanese Government has announced a $310 million payment for the acquisition of long lead items from the United Kingdom to support Australia’s future sovereign conventionally armed, nuclear powered submarine capability.

item.title: Power Generation Increased by Up to 70 Percent When Wind Turbines Were Combined with Tidal/Wave Installations
item.description: Combining wind turbines with wave, solar, and tidal devices on shared platforms reduces construction costs, improves stability and generates more reliable power, according to researchers from the University of Surrey.

item.title: SeaCast Revolutionizes Mediterranean Sea Forecasting with AI-Powered Speed and Accuracy
item.description: SeaCast is an innovative high-resolution forecasting system for the Mediterranean that harnesses AI to deliver faster and more energy-efficient predictions than traditional models. Unlike existing global AI models, which operate at lower resolutions and primarily rely on ocean data, SeaCast integrates both ocean and atmospheric variables, capturing complex regional dynamics. item.title: Seaworthy Collective Announces Cohort 7 of the Ocean Enterprise Studio & Incubator
item.description: Seaworthy Collective, a Miami-based non-profit that supports current and aspiring entrepreneurs in BlueTech (ocean innovation), has announced its next wave of startups and founders selected for Cohort 7 of its flagship Startup Program, The Continuum Ocean Enterprise Studio and Incubator.
